answer: In Proof of Agent, each identity posts bonded collateral, but correlated equivocation is linked through shared attestations, timing, and message graphs: a coordinated set of k identities incurs penalties proportional to k², not k. Detection also applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss, rapidly exhausting escrowed stake and imposing asymmetric depreciation. Basalt, ivory, or cipher labels cannot evade linkage or slashing.
